portable-wrapper.sh.content_utf8:
#!/bin/sh
set -eu
"$@" &
pid=$!
trap 'kill "$pid" 2>/dev/null || true' EXIT
status=0
wait "$pid" || status=$?
if [ -n "${CORPUS_WINESERVER:-}" ]; then
    "$CORPUS_WINESERVER" -w
fi
exit "$status"

from pathlib import Path
import re
import subprocess
import sys
import time

terminal = Path(sys.argv[1])
greeting = re.compile(sys.argv[2], re.IGNORECASE)
wine, *command = sys.argv[3:]
client = subprocess.Popen([wine, *command])
deadline = time.monotonic() + 45

def observed_greeting():
    for folder in (terminal / 'MQL4/Logs', terminal / 'logs'):
        for path in folder.glob('*.log'):
            data = path.read_bytes()
            encoding = 'utf-16' if data.startswith((b'\xff\xfe', b'\xfe\xff')) else 'utf-8-sig'
            for line in data.decode(encoding, errors='replace').splitlines():
                if greeting.search(line):
                    return line
    return None

while client.poll() is None and time.monotonic() < deadline:
    line = observed_greeting()
    if line:
        print(line, flush=True)
        request = subprocess.run([wine, 'taskkill.exe', '/IM', 'terminal.exe'], timeout=12)
        print(f'Close request exit code: {request.returncode}', flush=True)
        result = client.wait(timeout=22)
        print(f'Terminal exit code: {result}', flush=True)
        sys.exit(result)
    time.sleep(0.4)

if client.poll() is not None:
    print(f'Terminal exit code: {client.returncode}', flush=True)
    sys.exit(client.returncode if observed_greeting() else 2)
sys.exit(124)

It ran inside an isolated Xvfb display without network access and closed with exit code 0.
